company.name: Orbital Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Orbital Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that develops RNA-based medicines to treat disease in humans.
company.description: Orbital Therapeutics aims to enhance global health by unleashing the full potential of RNA-based medicines to treat human disease in ways that were not previously possible. To produce an extended portfolio of medications, the company is developing an innovative platform at the confluence of RNA technology, delivery techniques, data analytics, and automation.

productsAndServices.description: A technology-agnostic platform for designing RNA-based therapeutics tailored to specific disease biology, optimizing expression, duration, and tissue targeting.
productsAndServices.name: RNA Medicines Platform

productsAndServices.description: RNA-based treatments designed to modulate the immune system for autoimmune diseases and oncology by in vivo expression of CARs and immunomodulatory proteins.
productsAndServices.name: Immunomodulation RNA Therapeutics

productsAndServices.description: RNA vaccines designed to improve upon existing mRNA vaccines by enabling combination, heterologous prime-boost, and polyfunctional vaccine strategies.
productsAndServices.name: Next-Generation mRNA Vaccines

productsAndServices.description: RNA-based therapeutics that enable the expression of therapeutic proteins to treat genetic protein deficiencies and other conditions.
productsAndServices.name: Protein Therapeutics via RNA Medicines
